searchText: What is the size of a block in a blockchain? is it incremental(increasing) or static? If its *incremental* then if I'm a participant then how will I store the block in ever increasing network if I have limited space on the device? if it's *static* then how is data distributed in the block in ever increasing network? will I not have the copy of every data in the chain? If you google for something like "ethereum blockchain size stackexchange", you'll find plenty of discussion. See e.g. https://ethereum.stackexchange.com/questions/95029/ethereum-blockchain-size-growing-forever

What is the size of a block in a blockchain? is it incremental(increasing) or static?

if it's *static* then how is data distributed in the block in ever increasing network? will I not have the copy of every data in the chain?
